content.user_title: Practice Notes and Transpose Chords with Clef
content.value_statement: Music learners need focused help with note reading, chord symbols, and guitar tab. This skill combines guided drills, Clef MCP tools, and offline chord transposition.
actual_capabilities: Direct relevant music guide queries to the public MCP find_music_guides tool when connected.
Transpose chord symbols through the MCP transpose_chords tool after confirming direction and preferred enharmonic spelling.
Transpose chord roots and slash bass notes offline with the included Python helper, using sharps by default or optional flats.
Request piano chord spellings through the MCP spell_piano_chord tool.
Request ASCII guitar tab conversion through the MCP tab_to_piano_notes tool and clarify capo use when needed.
Guide a five-minute note-reading drill with one note at a time, delayed answers, missed-note repetition, and an observed-practice summary.
limitations: Remote music tools require a configured Clef MCP connection and a reachable third-party service; their implementations are not included.
The offline helper performs symbol-based transposition, not full score parsing or key-aware harmonic analysis.
The skill does not provide audio analysis, Guitar Pro support, or generated notation.
Guitar tab spacing does not establish rhythm, and chord spelling does not create a rhythmic arrangement.

use_cases.title: Practice Staff Notes
use_cases.description: Complete a short drill in a chosen clef and range, then repeat notes missed during the session.

use_cases.title: Prepare Chords for Rehearsal
use_cases.description: Move chord symbols and slash bass notes by a specified number of semitones using the offline helper.

use_cases.title: Explain Guitar Parts on Piano
use_cases.description: Use connected MCP tools to convert ASCII tab into piano notes and request chord spellings without inferring rhythm.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Note Drill
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a five-minute treble-clef drill around middle C. Show one note at a time and wait for my answer before revealing it.

prompt_templates.title: Offline Chord Transposition
prompt_templates.prompt: Transpose C Am F G up two semitones using the offline helper. Prefer sharps and preserve the chord qualities.

prompt_templates.title: Piano Chord Spelling
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the connected Clef MCP, spell Dm7, G7, and Cmaj7 as piano notes. Do not create rhythm or notation.

prompt_templates.title: Tab Conversion with Transposition
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this ASCII guitar tab to piano notes through Clef MCP: [paste tab]. Ask about capo placement before proceeding. Transpose the supplied chord symbols up three semitones with flat spellings. Keep pitches separate from rhythm assumptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced coordination of tab conversion and chord transposition

output_examples.input: Transpose C Am F G up two semitones with sharp spellings.
Transpose C/E F G down two semitones with flat spellings.
Start a treble-clef drill around middle C.
output_examples.output: First note: the bottom line of the treble staff. What is its letter name?

best_practices: Specify transposition direction, semitone distance, and preferred sharp or flat spellings before processing chord symbols.
Confirm capo placement for guitar tab and keep pitch conversion separate from rhythm interpretation.
Use only necessary music inputs with the public service; choose offline transposition when external processing is unnecessary.
anti_patterns: Sending credentials, private documents, or unrelated personal information to the public music endpoint.
Treating guitar tab spacing or a list of chord tones as a complete rhythmic arrangement.
Requesting audio transcription, Guitar Pro import, or notation generation as supported features.

faq.question: Which tasks does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It guides note-reading drills, chord transposition, piano chord spelling, music guide queries, and ASCII guitar tab conversion.

faq.question: Do I need an account or API key?
faq.answer: The documentation describes Clef MCP as public and requiring no authentication. Remote tasks still require an MCP connection and network access.

faq.question: Can I transpose chords without connecting MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. The included Python helper transposes chord roots and slash bass notes offline.

faq.question: Can I choose flats instead of sharps?
faq.answer: Yes. Confirm your preference before transposition. The offline helper defaults to sharps and provides a flats option.

faq.question: Does guitar tab conversion preserve rhythm?
faq.answer: No. The instructions explicitly state that tab spacing does not define rhythm. Capo placement should be clarified when unclear.

faq.question: Can it analyze recordings or generate notation?
faq.answer: No. Audio analysis, Guitar Pro support, and generated notation are explicitly outside the documented scope.
